name: festpass
description: FestPass - Distributed Campus Event Ticketing and Entry Validation System

scripts.cluster: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,magenta.bold,red.bold" --names "B1,B2,B3,G1,G2,G3" "npm run node:b1" "npm run node:b2" "npm run node:b3" "npm run node:g1" "npm run node:g2" "npm run node:g3"
scripts.node:b1: cross-env NODE_ID=B1 PORT=4001 NODE_ROLE=booth NODE_INDEX=1 npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.node:b2: cross-env NODE_ID=B2 PORT=4002 NODE_ROLE=booth NODE_INDEX=2 npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.node:b3: cross-env NODE_ID=B3 PORT=4003 NODE_ROLE=booth NODE_INDEX=3 npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.node:g1: cross-env NODE_ID=G1 PORT=4004 NODE_ROLE=gate NODE_INDEX=4 npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.node:g2: cross-env NODE_ID=G2 PORT=4005 NODE_ROLE=gate NODE_INDEX=5 npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.node:g3: cross-env NODE_ID=G3 PORT=4006 NODE_ROLE=gate NODE_INDEX=6 npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.node:dev:b1: cross-env NODE_ID=B1 PORT=4001 NODE_ROLE=booth NODE_INDEX=1 npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.node:dev:b2: cross-env NODE_ID=B2 PORT=4002 NODE_ROLE=booth NODE_INDEX=2 npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.node:dev:b3: cross-env NODE_ID=B3 PORT=4003 NODE_ROLE=booth NODE_INDEX=3 npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.node:dev:g1: cross-env NODE_ID=G1 PORT=4004 NODE_ROLE=gate NODE_INDEX=4 npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.node:dev:g2: cross-env NODE_ID=G2 PORT=4005 NODE_ROLE=gate NODE_INDEX=5 npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.node:dev:g3: cross-env NODE_ID=G3 PORT=4006 NODE_ROLE=gate NODE_INDEX=6 npm run dev -w apps/server
